name: Kokomo Cruises
summary: Family-owned Gold Coast operator running humpback whale watching cruises in the winter migration season, a 3.5 hour Broadwater sightseeing cruise with two island stops, and private charters. The vessel is based at Marina Mirage in Main Beach and was built in Brisbane for Queensland waters. The crew hold specialised marine qualifications and complete regular safety drills on board.
standouts: Family-owned and operated, based at Marina Mirage in Main Beach
Vessel built in Brisbane by Woody Marine Fabrications, with an underwater camera, a bow loader and three Yamaha outboards
Crew hold specialised marine qualifications and complete safety drills on board
Private charters include an inflatable dock, snorkels, beach games, surround sound and an esky with ice

contact.address: Marina Mirage, Main Beach, Gold Coast QLD

trips.title: Whale Watching Cruise
trips.summary: A 2.5 hour cruise from Marina Mirage out to the humpback whale migration route off the Gold Coast, about 20 minutes from the marina. The crew gives live commentary on whale facts and local sights, and the boat has an underwater camera and two drop-down screens. A licensed bar, snacks and tour photos can be bought on board.
highlights: Live commentary on whale facts and sightseeing
Underwater camera with two drop-down TV displays
Licensed bar, snacks and photos to buy on board
Three departures a day, the 2:30pm one on weekends only

trips.title: City to Surf Sightseeing Cruise
trips.summary: A 3.5 hour cruise on the Gold Coast Broadwater, from the Surfers Paradise skyline to the nature reserves around Jumpinpin Bar, with commentary on the places you pass. There are two island stop-offs with time to swim, try paddleboarding or play a hole-in-one challenge. Guests can join at Marina Mirage in Main Beach or at Surfers Paradise.
highlights: Paddleboarding, a hole-in-one challenge and swimming in tide pools
Commentary on the Gold Coast and the Broadwater
Snacks and drinks from the onboard bar; BYO food and non-alcoholic drinks welcome

trips.title: Private Whale Watching
trips.summary: A private whale watching cruise for your own group, holding up to 47 guests, with the captain finding the humpbacks and giving commentary. The minimum booking is 2.5 hours, and catering, drinks packages and music can be arranged around your group. It is available from June to October.

trips.title: Private Charter
trips.summary: Private hire of the Kokomo vessel for up to 40 guests, for birthdays, hens parties, school and seniors groups and other functions. Charters can follow a Broadwater cruise, a picnic stop at Wave Break Island or a longer trip up the Coomera River, or be planned around your group. The boat has a large open deck, deep lounges, a day bed, surround sound and a bow loader for beach drop-offs.
